gait.stride_length_definition: Planar net displacement of trunk_middle between observed same-foot touchdowns; not a speed-residualized laboratory mean.
gait.cycle_metric_semantics: Fields named stride refer operationally to observed same-foot contact cycles; these are NOT verified biological strides or guaranteed oscillator cycles.

limitations: Single-speed calibration, not statistical or kinematic validation.
Touch threshold is an engineering load detector, not tactile receptor sensitivity.
Foot-site velocity includes pad rotation/rolling; it is not exact contact-point slip.
Joint-angle proxies are not yet validated against the Jagnandan landmark convention.
Biological SEM and raw/residualized multi-lab values are not universal tolerances.
Temperatures label the literature validity envelope; this model has no thermal dynamics.

deferred.frequency_speed_regression: requires descending drive and a matched multi-speed protocol
deferred.stride_length_speed_regression: requires descending drive and a matched multi-speed protocol
deferred.tail_amplitude_speed_regression: requires descending drive and a matched multi-speed protocol
deferred.tail_height_speed_regression: requires descending drive and a matched multi-speed protocol
deferred.COM_energy_recovery: Not computed from trunk proxy; requires whole-model COM and a matched speed protocol.
deferred.strike_shake: 50 Hz gait trace cannot resolve strike kinematics; log >=500 Hz before filtering.

gait.diagonality_definition: Circular temporal separation of diagonal touchdown pairs; 0=simultaneous. Not an independently validated scalar index.

contact_quality.frequency_warning_rule: ENGINEERED diagnostic, not a biological gate; cycle count divided by total observed complete-cycle time versus recorded commanded frequency.
contact_quality.note: Failed entrainment is retained, never repaired by oscillator-locked event selection. No-cycle limbs are unmeasurable, not valid zero-frequency gait.

diagnosis.claim: Simulation diagnosis only; raw contacts are not verified biological strides.

sampling.window_convention: Positions include start; force/velocity endpoints use (start,end], excluding reset and the interval ending exactly at start.
sampling.acquisition_status: high-rate trace supplied; acquisition authenticity depends on recorder provenance

diagnosis.repeat_unit: One deterministic trajectory; repeated identical seeds/runs are not independent samples.

commands.command_time_source: samples.command_time_s: recorded executed held interval start
commands.phase_source: samples.commanded_phase_fraction: recorded phase used for held control
commands.note: Desired stance is not observed support. Legacy reward target phase/clock is not treated as controller command.

force_semantics.definition: MuJoCo touch sensor scalar sum of included contact-normal forces; NOT world-vertical force, vector resultant or tissue receptor sensitivity.

signed_body_forward_speed_m_s.source: recorded trunk-local signed forward velocity, not path speed or fixed-world-axis progress

debounce.method: shortest bounded run first; ties earliest; censored edges retained; no forcing to one event per commanded cycle

limitations: Endpoint load fraction is a sampled-time estimate, not a continuous contact integral.
Entrainment is an engineered controller-tracking diagnostic, not biological validation.
Contact-cycle duty and limb phase remain unvalidated when entrainment fails; all raw events remain counted.
Phase-binned touch means describe this simulator, not measured muscle or animal force waveforms.

claim: Manual diagnostic trial, no policy training; n=1, no across-repeat SD.
